propositions: git commit --amend -F and --amend -m drop the Change-Id trailer, causing Gerrit to stamp a new one and create a duplicate change instead of a new patchset
A git hook cannot distinguish between amending with -F and creating a fresh commit with -F, so hooks cannot preserve the Change-Id on amend
A make amend-msg wrapper must read the current Change-Id from HEAD, preserve it while rewriting the message from FILE, and fail loudly if HEAD has no Change-Id
The wrapper must be documented in AGENTS.md as the path for rewriting commit messages, with explicit warning that --amend -m/-F creates duplicate changes
The implementation must pass tests proving the wrapper preserves Change-Id equality while the naive form changes it, and that loud failure occurs when Change-Id is missing
